inspect: Whole site: house remains legible; distinguish pedestrian gate/path, separate vehicle opening and turning apron, three trees, carport and PV.

Start on the street using the visible walk selector. Test near/far operation, closed collisions from both sides, an unobstructed inward swing, refusal to close on a walker in the opening, re-latching from each side and a continuous return.

Walk the route to the house entrance and back. Walk the independent clear drive through the east opening of both parking bays. Inspect fence and trees from multiple positions; approach each trunk under its raised crown.
The frontage is partial. No surveyed parcel, exact road width, species identification, vehicle engineering, utilities or carport-store interior review is implied.
